adapters.description: Deterministic test double with selectable behaviour. Used for infrastructure tests; produces no model results.
Applies predefined file contents and commands per task. Exercises the full sandbox/patch/grading pipeline deterministically without a model.
Runs an agent command line inside the sandbox. The CLI and its credentials must be present in the task image; nothing is mounted from the host.

command.description: shell command executed in the repo workdir

secret_env.description: names of host environment variables forwarded into the sandbox; values are never stored or logged

usage_file.description: optional sandbox path to a JSON file the agent writes with input_tokens/output_tokens/cost_usd

adapters.description: Host-side agent loop; tools run inside the sandbox. Works with any endpoint exposing /chat/completions with tool calling.

request_timeout_s.description: Per-request read timeout, 10-1800 s; always clamped to the run's remaining budget. Raise it for slow local or reasoning models.
